title: Winged orange glowing beings over skywatch groups

tellings.quote: And we get things that appear to have wings, orange glowing beings, as many as 20 at the time, fly 25 ft over our head

plain: At skywatches, gatherings where people wait out at night to watch the sky, as many as 20 orange glowing beings that seem to have wings have flown about 25 feet over the group's heads, according to Chris Bledsoe, a man the show describes as attracting UFOs and being studied by NASA. Bledsoe says he was there and saw them himself.
